trust_decision.summary: The controller trusts a relative path handed to it by fetched content (bucket object keys) and by the CR spec (GitRepository spec.sparseCheckout) to stay inside its working directory; the decision is made by plain filepath.Join inside the reconcilers, with no resolve-with-securejoin step.

landing_point.why: It is the only SecureJoin call in a reconciler, so an engineer grepping the tree for 'path handling' after reading the one-line advisory lands on the GitRepository include path resolution and treats it as the pattern to copy.

fix_sites.entry_point: BucketReconciler.Reconcile -> fetchIndexFiles -> provider.FGetObject (Bucket CR spec.bucketName/prefix; keys come from the remote bucket listing)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/bucket/gcp/gcp.go:216 (same shape: internal/bucket/azure/blob.go:304, internal/bucket/minio/minio.go:324), reached through the exported BucketProvider.FGetObject at internal/controller/bucket_controller.go:151

O3_reason_to_dismiss: FGetObject is a storage-provider primitive whose documented contract is 'write to the caller-supplied targetPath' (internal/controller/bucket_controller.go:148-151), so path validation is claimed to belong to the reconciler that builds the path, not to the provider.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Bucket object keys legitimately contain subdirectories (a Helm chart stored as charts/mychart-0.1.0.tgz); the index stores the key verbatim and the artifact is built from the nested layout, so a fix that takes filepath.Base, strips '/', or rejects keys containing '..' anywhere breaks normal bucket-prefixed sources.

O6_input_shapes: sparse-checkout entry with a leading './' (trimmed at internal/controller/gitrepository_controller.go:996 before use)

O7_producer.where: api/v1/gitrepository_types.go:166 (SparseCheckout []string carries no pattern/format validation; likewise GitRepositoryInclude.FromPath at api/v1/gitrepository_types.go:180)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Source artifact is untarred into the Helm chart work dir with tar.Untar but without tar.WithSkipSymlinks, so symlink entries are materialised and later loads resolve through them.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The shared archive/tar helper already validates entry paths, and the OCI sibling route is the one that is exposed to arbitrary registries; this artefact comes from another Flux source, so it is argued to be covered.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Include copy uses the caller-supplied fromPath with no check at this layer, while only toPath is securejoined.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: fromPath is resolved inside fluxcd/pkg/artifact/storage, outside this repository, so 'not our code / already handled downstream' is available; the route is dismissed as out of the advisory's scope.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second object fetched by a fixed name (the ignore file) joined onto tempDir, mirroring the indexed-object fetch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The reconciler already special-cases the ignore object, so a maintainer adding 'fetch this well-known key too' would copy the same filepath.Join idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A values-file or chart subdirectory resolved from the untarred source dir with filepath.Join before handoff.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The HelmChart build path already joins tmpDir with fixed names; a feature adding a caller-selected subdirectory there is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Chart metadata loaded by joining a caller-supplied relative dir with Chart.yaml.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other chart read path in internal/helm/chart goes through secureloader, so a new caller that passes a resolved directory string slips in without the check.

O9_family: CWE-23 relative path traversal (path resolution of untrusted relative components before filesystem use)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.0 (go.mod:3); two modules (root + ./api with replace, go.mod:5); make targets in Makefile, envtest binaries via make install-envtest
O10_build.project_tests: internal/controller/*_test.go run under envtest with mock object stores and a test artifact server; unit coverage for the chart path area in internal/helm/chart/secureloader/directory_test.go:263 and internal/helm/chart/builder_local_test.go:308 ('../../../traversing/illegally/...'); bucket providers have unit tests in internal/bucket/{gcp,minio,azure}.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Sanitise only the one path the report names (clean/reject '..' on the object key, or filepath.Clean on the sparse-checkout entry) inside the same function that built it, leaving the provider API, the include fromPath and the Helm untar route untouched.
